name: HTF-LTF FVG/OB Confluence Entry [Manual Build]
raw_text: HTF-LTF FVG/OB Confluence Entry (intraday v1 only, per the task's own instruction -- no swing/weekly variant built). Bias TF: 4H -- marks Support/Resistance, Order Blocks, and FVGs. Entry TF: 15m -- looks for a matching FVG/OB in the SAME direction as HTF bias. HARD FILTER (High Probability Zone): HTF and LTF trend (trend_regime, own 3-way up/down/sideways classifier) must match; HTF sideways or HTF/LTF mismatch = skip entirely (a genuinely unclear HTF trend can satisfy neither the bullish nor bearish gate, so this is enforced by construction, no separate check needed). Order Block mitigation: an OB invalidates the instant price closes back through it before an entry occurs (reuses the same close-through-the-zone trigger breaker_blocks() already uses). Entry (long, HTF bullish; short is a builder's own MIRRORED default, since the source only detailed longs explicitly): price retraces to touch the 15m bullish FVG -- 50% level preferred, full-zone touch as fallback (represented as one first-touch-of-zone event per distinct gap; see the block's own comment for why the two collapse to one mechanism here). Stop-loss: slightly beyond the FVG zone, or its 50% level if the FVG-producing candle was unusually large (1.5x ATR14, own default) -- 0.65% buffer (cost_model-verified safe). Take-profit: structure-based -- nearest swing/HTF level (naturally produces high RR, no fixed ratio forced). No session restriction, 24/7. Risk 1% default.
